name: Glorious Heat — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Glorious Heat from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Glorious Heat" but are not part of the Glorious Heat entry, which is unchanged.

Editor’s Note

Errata is only released when a book is reprinted and soft-cover books (which is where this feat came from) are almost never reprinted. As a result there will likely never be any official errata released for this spell. However, the original developer (Mark Moreland) and Lead Designer (Jason Bulmahn) have had this to say about it:

“Were we to reprint the book, we would change the Glorious Heat feat to grant the fire spell’s spell level in healing instead of character level. This keeps unlimited use orisons from being spammed, and 1st level spells from being abused at higher levels. This clarification will appear in the July update to the Pathfinder Society Additional Resources document.”

[Source]

“Unlimited healing at the cost of a feat and an orison slot is just too good. This is a fix. It is neither elegant, nor my preferred solution (which would have been to catch this before it went to print, but mistakes do slip through), it is simply a fix for the OP system. This fix will go into official campaign documentation, unless Mark and Hyrum decide that instead a ban is more appropriate.”

[Source]
